Constant (86000*2) delay after which a successful proposal can execute.
Minimum forVotes (5000e18) required for a proposal to succeed.

IERC20 token used for voting; external contract target of transfer/transferFrom calls.
Total number of proposals ever created; incremented in propose.
Mapping(uint => Proposal) holding all proposal records including txHash and executed flag.
Mapping(uint => mapping(address => Receipt)) tracking per-voter ballot receipts.
Mapping(address => uint) timestamp until which a voter's tokens remain locked.
Mapping(address => uint) internal vote-token balances minted/burned by the contract.
Modifier that pulls the caller's full token balance via transferFrom, mints internal balance and sets voteLock.
Sets the votingToken reference at deployment.
View function computing ProposalState from timestamps and vote tallies.
Executes a queued proposal via delegatecall to _target with _data after state checks.
Creates a new proposal after lockVotes, storing proposer, startTime and txHash.
Casts a vote on an active proposal, tallying forVotes/againstVotes and writing a receipt.
Returns tokens to the caller after voteLock expiry and burns internal balance.
Internal helper adding _amount to balanceOf[_account].
Internal helper subtracting _amount from balanceOf[_account].
Caller-controlled address used for balances, receipts, proposer and withdrawal recipient.
Miner-influenced timestamp driving proposal state, vote lock and startTime.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns _votingToken into the votingToken state variable.
Constructor parameter _votingToken flows into votingToken.
state() validates proposalCount against proposalId.
state() reads proposals[proposalId] to derive the proposal state.
state() uses votingPeriod to bound the active window.
state() uses executionPeriod to decide PendingExecution vs ReadyForExecution.
state() compares forVotes against quorumVotes.
state() parameter proposalId indexes the proposals mapping.
Local storage pointer proposal carries proposals[proposalId] data inside state().
execute() reads proposals[_proposalId] and later flips proposal.executed.
execute() calls state(_proposalId) to require ReadyForExecution.
execute() invokes the delegatecall to _target with _data.
delegatecall executes arbitrary external code in the contract's context, enabling reentrant state manipulation.
execute() forwards its _proposalId parameter to state().
_target is hashed into the local txHash in execute().
_data is hashed into the local txHash in execute().
Computed txHash is compared against proposal.txHash to validate the proposal.
Caller-controlled _target is used as the delegatecall target.
Caller-controlled _data is used as the delegatecall payload.
propose() is guarded by the lockVotes modifier.
propose() requires balanceOf[msg.sender] >= proposalThreshold.
propose() compares the caller balance against proposalThreshold.
propose() increments proposalCount for the new proposal id.
propose() writes the new proposal into the proposals mapping.
propose() hashes _target into the local txHash.
propose() hashes _data into the local txHash.
The txHash computed in propose() is stored inside the new proposal record.
The newProposal struct is persisted into proposals.
vote() is guarded by the lockVotes modifier.
vote() calls state(_proposalId) to require the Active state.
vote() loads proposals[_proposalId] into a storage pointer.
vote() reads and writes receipts[_proposalId][msg.sender].
vote() reads balanceOf[msg.sender] to determine voting weight.
vote() forwards _proposalId to state().
The _support flag selects which vote tally is incremented.
Local votes amount is added into the proposal tally.
The proposals storage pointer receives the incremented forVotes/againstVotes.
The receipt storage pointer is written with hasVoted, support and votes.
vote() performs the unchecked-in-spirit tally addition proposal.forVotes/againstVotes += votes.
withdraw() compares block.timestamp against voteLock to gate withdrawal.
withdraw() reads voteLock[msg.sender] for the expiry check.
withdraw() transfers and burns balanceOf[msg.sender].
withdraw() calls _burn to zero the internal balance.
withdraw() performs the ERC20 transfer to the caller.
The external token transfer in withdraw() hands control to the token/caller before _burn completes.
withdraw() sends tokens to msg.sender, a caller-controlled address, before state is finalized.
lockVotes reads the caller balance from the votingToken contract.
lockVotes operates on balances and locks keyed by msg.sender.
lockVotes sets voteLock[msg.sender] = block.timestamp + votingPeriod.
lockVotes writes the new lock timestamp into voteLock.
lockVotes calls the external transferFrom on the voting token.
The external transferFrom call in lockVotes grants control to the token before all bookkeeping completes.
The locally read tokenBalance is the amount passed to transferFrom.
_mint credits the internal balanceOf mapping.
_mint performs balanceOf[_account] += _amount.
_amount is the value added to balanceOf in _mint.
_burn debits the internal balanceOf mapping.
_burn performs balanceOf[_account] -= _amount.
_amount is the value subtracted from balanceOf in _burn.
msg.sender becomes the proposal proposer and threshold-check subject.
msg.sender selects the voter receipt and voting weight in vote().
msg.sender determines the balance and lock checked and paid out in withdraw().
block.timestamp (miner-controllable) determines the returned ProposalState.
block.timestamp is recorded as the proposal startTime.
block.timestamp gates the withdraw() lock expiry check.
